title: DUET: fast two-part hurdle testing for single-cell differential expression in Python
description: DUET implements cell-level two-part hurdle testing and a donor-level pseudobulk arm in Python. The moderated continuous component differs from MAST. Underflow-safe log-scale values preserve ranking information. Publication V4 includes saved simulation results, benchmarks, scripts and explicit limitations; no universal FDR or category-sensitivity advantage is claimed.
